purpose: Design and verify bounded spatial layouts, route topology, objective/encounter placement, traversal rhythm, spawn/use zones, risk/reward geography, and level affordances so space creates meaningful player problems without silently taking ownership of gameplay mechanics, systems balance, or art direction.

owns: Traversal rhythm, spatial risk/reward, and level affordances.
Reachability and route-cost evidence for exact geometry.
does_not_own: Human route readability merely because geometry is machine-reachable.
escalates_when: Route costs materially alter systems solvability/pressure.
Required objective becomes unreachable or evidence belongs to stale composition.

minimum_capabilities: Separate topology evidence from human readability judgment.
adaptation_rules: Deterministic flows may calculate reachability/path costs but cannot prove human readability/pacing.
Model intuition about level quality is not evidence by itself.
Human designers may use equivalent maps/tools while preserving evidence boundaries.

reads: Exact movement/collision and system pressure contracts.
Current geometry and prior QA/readability evidence.
writes: Bounded spatial deltas and route measurements.
coordination_contracts: World may request gameplay/system changes but not silently implement their intent.
Reachability does not equal human clarity/fun.

inputs.description: Grounded objective/traversal/encounter problem space should create or repair.
Current geometry plus movement/collision and relevant system constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded geometry/placement/topology change with measured route evidence.

references.scope: Bounded bulkhead topology, collision reachability, and route-cost evidence.
Exact-composition route geometry with current systems/QA evidence and Chromium inspection.

retrieval_rules: Read exact movement/collision and current geometry before route claims.
Retrieve current system pressure before claiming route changes preserve solvability.
uncertainty_rules: Pathfinding proves reachability only under its modeled collision/movement contract.
Human route discovery, pacing, fairness, tension, and fun remain separate evidence categories.

skills.description: Shape route alternatives and spatial constraints around a grounded player problem.
Verify objectives/routes under exact movement/collision predicate.
evidence_required: Exact geometry and collision model are identified.

skills.description: Measure materially different route classes and consequences.
evidence_required: Measurement method and route endpoints are explicit.

skills.description: Separate geometric proof from visual/human readability claims.
evidence_required: Each spatial claim names its evidence surface.

tools.failure_boundary: Unknown exact geometry blocks route claim.

tools.purpose: Calculate traversable graph/path existence under declared movement/collision model.
Measure route classes/distances/times under exact composition.

forbidden_actions: Claim human intuitive navigation without appropriate validation.
tools.failure_boundary: No rendered observation means no visual-inspection claim.

procedures.trigger: A spatial route/objective/encounter problem needs a bounded level-design delta.
steps: Ground player problem and exact spatial composition.
Create smallest spatial delta that serves the problem.
Recheck all required reachability and route classes.
Inspect/validate appropriate spatial cues and publish evidence.
stop_conditions: Layout only works by silently changing another profession's contract.
Claim requires human readability/fun evidence not available.

canonical: Validated spatial-design procedures, topology/reachability contracts, and evidence boundaries.
project: Accepted geometry/objectives/routes and known traversal constraints.
forbidden_to_promote_silently: Diagnostic path as human route preference.
retention_rules: Recompute spatial evidence when geometry or movement/collision contract changes.

state_interfaces.reason: Spatial evidence depends on movement contract.
World may expose route consequences but not silently retune systems.

claim_rules: Machine route analysis is not human route readability/playtest.
Visual inspection proves visible composition only, not subjective quality.
minimum_for_working: Representative reachability/topology/objective/encounter fixtures pass across multiple level shapes and movement contracts.
At least two executor/intelligence conditions preserve ownership/evidence boundaries.
Interactive/human evidence exists for readability/pacing claims included in scope.

may_decide: Bounded world/encounter geometry and placement within accepted game identity/verbs.
must_not_decide: Large scope/content expansion without grounded player problem.

failure_library.symptom: Required objective cannot be traversed under exact collision model.
checks: Exact reachability analysis and interactive route probe.
repair_path: Repair geometry without silently changing movement contract.

failure_library.symptom: Machine path exists and is called intuitive to players.
repair_path: Downgrade claim and request appropriate evidence.

professional_tests.fixture: Open space makes all objectives equivalent straight-line choices.
expected_observations: Body identifies weak spatial consequence without inventing a new game verb.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Proposes bounded topology tied to grounded player problem.

professional_tests.fixture: Movement/collision behavior changes after route measurements were recorded.
expected_observations: Prior route evidence is recognized as stale.

promotion_requirements: Broaden beyond compact 2D topology into varied level/encounter forms.
Expand professional fixtures before status promotion.
